basic_info.description: Coveted Corona Heights single family home with multiple view decks, and a secluded outdoor party space on the top floor. Built in 2007. San Francisco and Bay Bridge views 3BR/2.5BA home, walking distance to parks, Castro St, Noe & Cole Valley. Hardwood flooring, new bedroom carpeting, in-house data system, intercom system, open kitchen floor plan, voluminous ceilings, designer fixtures, gas fireplace. Gourmet kitchen with granite countertops, gas cooktop, stainless built-in fridge. Rear patio & panoramic view deck off master suite. Limestone baths, clear glass shower doors, spa tub. 2-car garage. Dumbwaiter makes easy delivery of groceries to the kitchen. One of a kind home in a terrific location.
